title: St Helens Borough Council – augmenting TEC with AI
summary: St Helens built AI tools that match care assessments to a technology catalog and draft personalized care plans. Improved resident independence remains an intended benefit.
account: St Helens Borough Council built an AI-integrated technology-enabled-care catalog using Microsoft Copilot Studio. Care professionals co-curated the catalog. The source describes predictive matching between care-assessment information and suitable technology options, followed by generative AI that drafts personalized care plans and associated costings. This supplies a reported planning capability intended to support residents returning home and living independently. The source gives no individual return-home outcome or evaluated care improvement. Its separate discussion of medication-dispenser savings and in-house development costs does not establish savings produced by AI and is not credited to this case.
purpose: Match care needs to technology-enabled support and generate personalized care plans.
system: St Helens AI-integrated technology-enabled-care catalog and planning tools built with Microsoft Copilot Studio
developer: St Helens Borough Council using Microsoft Copilot Studio
domain: Adult social care and care planning

ratings.reason: The council reports a built AI workflow that matches care assessments to a technology catalog and generates personalized care plans. This is a planning-capability benefit, without an established cost saving or resident outcome.
Better matching and independent living are intended, but the source does not define an achieved resident outcome.

ai_role.statement: Predictive matching links care-assessment information to catalog options, and generative AI drafts personalized care plans. The source identifies this functionality but does not establish improved resident outcomes or AI-produced financial savings.

evidence.citation: Local Government Association, AI case-study bank. Council or project account published by LGA. Hosting and editorial curation do not establish independent outcome evaluation.

produced_by: The council used Microsoft Copilot Studio to combine care-assessment information with a technology catalog co-curated by care professionals.

must_hold: The source does not establish which conditions are necessary to reproduce a care or efficiency outcome.
